notes.title: 1.1.2 - Leaderboards Update + Future Plans!
notes.content: [p]It's been a little longer than expected, but finally got the Leaderboard Update tested and ready for the upcoming Summer Steam Sale![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155863/e34e5af23f9144b94d5bfffac83cd8ceba9a055c.png"][/img][/p][p]Go for the top time and top scores in your favourite levels or simply try and take on the Gauntlet to prove you're the best assassin out there![/p][p][/p][h3]Future Plans[/h3][p]I still plan on adding more to the game including a second gauntlet that's mostly finished, as well as a Temple Defence/Raid mode similar to something like Zombies mode from CoD with a few rogue-like elements thrown in as that's always a genre I've wanted to experiment with. [/p][p][/p][p]Progress will be a little slower than before due to transitioning to full-time hours with other work, but there are still plans for this game and any support goes a long way in helping with more resources to speed up development![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading, and hope you enjoy! (P.S. if you have any feedback or want to follow the development, hop on down to our [url="https://discord.gg/XGWWVCHrrP"]Discord[/url])[/p]
